title: AP three-way invoice, PO, and receipt exception matching
description: Bounded synthetic invoice/PO/receipt comparisons, globally non-overlapping proposed quantities, remaining capacities and an atomic AP review queue. No posting or payment.

sample_policy.description: SYN-FIN Demonstration Company and every input identifier, quantity, amount, threshold and approval are invented. Review-only classification, not production accounting, regulatory advice or real authority.

golden_provenance.author: Financial-services AP scenario owner
golden_provenance.description: Full envelopes manually authored from approved FS-02 arithmetic and document/capacity worksheets before writing baseline business logic or executing it. No computed baseline output or baseline import used to derive or repair answers. The pre-execution golden lock preserves those declarations; this is not independent human AP approval.
